import json, math, itertools, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
OUT="/agent/jobs/ad7edfe9-b6a6-4270-b5cb-6f473ffd667f/provenance"
seqs=json.load(open(f"{OUT}/allantoicase_seqs.json"))
zp=open(f"{OUT}/zebrafish_allc_ref.txt").read().strip()
print("Ensembl zebrafish == UniProt Q6DGA6 ?", zp==seqs["Q6DGA6"], len(zp), len(seqs["Q6DGA6"]))
maps=json.load(open(f"{OUT}/map_to_yeast.json"))
y2z={int(a)+1:b+1 for a,b in maps["Q6DGA6"].items()}   # yeast 1-based -> zebrafish 1-based
yeast_patch=[39,42,69,70,71,72,75,82,101,102,105,107,108,171,172,173,174,176,177,
             197,225,230,232,233,234,235,236,238,243,252,265,266,271,272,297,324,331,332,333,334,337,339]
zpatch=sorted({y2z[y] for y in yeast_patch if y in y2z})
print("patch positions mapped to zebrafish:", len(zpatch), zpatch)

bases="TCAG"; codons=[a+b+c for a in bases for b in bases for c in bases]
aas="FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG"; CODE=dict(zip(codons,aas))
def scnt(cod):
    if CODE.get(cod) in (None,"*"): return None
    return (sum(sum(1 for b in "TCAG" if b!=cod[i] and CODE.get(cod[:i]+b+cod[i+1:])==CODE[cod])/3.0 for i in range(3)),)
SITE={}
for c in codons:
    if CODE.get(c) in (None,"*"): continue
    S=sum(sum(1 for b in "TCAG" if b!=c[i] and CODE.get(c[:i]+b+c[i+1:])==CODE[c])/3.0 for i in range(3))
    SITE[c]=(S,3.0-S)
def dcnt(c1,c2):
    pos=[i for i in range(3) if c1[i]!=c2[i]]
    if not pos: return 0.0,0.0
    ts=tn=0.0; k=0
    for perm in itertools.permutations(pos):
        cur=c1; s=n=0.0; ok=True
        for i in perm:
            nx=cur[:i]+c2[i]+cur[i+1:]
            if CODE.get(cur) in (None,"*") or CODE.get(nx) in (None,"*"): ok=False; break
            if CODE[cur]==CODE[nx]: s+=1
            else: n+=1
            cur=nx
        if ok: ts+=s; tn+=n; k+=1
    return (ts/k,tn/k) if k else None
def jc(p):
    v=1-4*p/3
    return -0.75*math.log(v) if v>0 else float("nan")

def per_pair(hom, patchset, levels, reflen):
    out=[]
    for h in hom:
        if h["taxonomy_level"] not in levels or h["type"]!="ortholog_one2one": continue
        s,t=h["source"]["align_seq"],h["target"]["align_seq"]
        if len(s)!=len(t): continue
        sc=[s[i:i+3] for i in range(0,len(s)-len(s)%3,3)]; tc=[t[i:i+3] for i in range(0,len(t)-len(t)%3,3)]
        acc={"patch":dict(N=0.,S=0.,Nd=0.,Sd=0.),"rest":dict(N=0.,S=0.,Nd=0.,Sd=0.)}
        n=0
        for c1,c2 in zip(sc,tc):
            if c1=="---": continue
            n+=1
            if "-" in c2 or "N" in c2 or c1 not in SITE or c2 not in SITE: continue
            d=dcnt(c1,c2)
            if d is None: continue
            k="patch" if n in patchset else "rest"
            s1,n1=SITE[c1]; s2,n2=SITE[c2]
            acc[k]["N"]+=(n1+n2)/2; acc[k]["S"]+=(s1+s2)/2; acc[k]["Sd"]+=d[0]; acc[k]["Nd"]+=d[1]
        row=dict(species=h["target"]["species"], level=h["taxonomy_level"])
        ok=True
        for k in ("patch","rest"):
            a=acc[k]
            if a["N"]==0 or a["S"]==0: ok=False; break
            dN,dS=jc(a["Nd"]/a["N"]), jc(a["Sd"]/a["S"])
            row[f"dN_{k}"]=dN; row[f"dS_{k}"]=dS; row[f"w_{k}"]=dN/dS if dS and dS>0 else np.nan
            for f in ("N","S","Nd","Sd"): row[f"{f}_{k}"]=a[f]
        if ok: out.append(row)
    return pd.DataFrame(out)

FISH={"Clupeocephala","Otophysi","Cyprinoidei","Otomorpha","Osteoglossocephalai","Neopterygii","Actinopterygii"}
dz=json.load(open(f"{OUT}/ALLC_zebrafish_homologies.json"))
F=per_pair(dz, set(zpatch), FISH, 395)
F=F[(F.dS_rest>0.15)&(F.dS_rest<2.5)].dropna(subset=["w_patch","w_rest"])
print("\nfish pairs used:", len(F))
print("fish: median w_patch=%.3f  w_rest=%.3f" % (F.w_patch.median(), F.w_rest.median()))
print("fish pooled: w_patch=%.3f w_rest=%.3f" % (jc(F.Nd_patch.sum()/F.N_patch.sum())/jc(F.Sd_patch.sum()/F.S_patch.sum()),
                                                 jc(F.Nd_rest.sum()/F.N_rest.sum())/jc(F.Sd_rest.sum()/F.S_rest.sum())))
E=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/ALLC_dnds_per_species.csv")
MAMM={"Boreoeutheria","Euarchontoglires","Catarrhini","Primates","Eutheria","Theria","Mammalia","Simiiformes","Hominidae","Hominoidea","Haplorrhini"}
Mm=E[E.taxlevel.isin(MAMM)&(E.type=="ortholog_one2one")&(E.dS_all>0.15)&(E.dS_all<2.5)].dropna(subset=["w_patch","w_rest"])
print("\nmammal pairs used:", len(Mm), "median w_patch=%.3f w_rest=%.3f"%(Mm.w_patch.median(),Mm.w_rest.median()))
u=stats.mannwhitneyu(Mm.w_patch, F.w_patch)
print("Mann-Whitney mammal vs fish w_patch: U=%.0f p=%.3g"%(u.statistic,u.pvalue))
u2=stats.mannwhitneyu(Mm.w_rest, F.w_rest)
print("Mann-Whitney mammal vs fish w_rest : U=%.0f p=%.3g"%(u2.statistic,u2.pvalue))
F.to_csv(f"{OUT}/fish_dnds_per_species.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.5)) if False else (None,None)
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,5))
data=[Mm.w_patch.values, F.w_patch.values, Mm.w_rest.values, F.w_rest.values]
bp=ax.boxplot(data, labels=["mammals\npocket","teleosts\npocket","mammals\nrest","teleosts\nrest"], showfliers=False, patch_artist=True)
for p,c in zip(bp["boxes"],["#1d3557","#2a9d8f","#a8b7c7","#a7d8cf"]): p.set_facecolor(c)
for i,d in enumerate(data):
    ax.scatter(np.random.normal(i+1,0.06,len(d)), d, s=9, c="k", alpha=.35)
ax.set_ylabel("dN/dS vs reference species")
ax.set_title("ALLC pocket is as constrained in mammals (no allantoate)\nas in teleosts (active urate degradation)", fontsize=11)
